note: A1+ Unit 2 Lesson 2.14, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user approved the A1+ Unit 2 plan on 2026-11-19 (A1+ 2.Y follows A1 2.Y, one grammar step each) and chose "Straight to Preview": no per-lesson gates, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, reviewed in Preview. Batch C (2.11-2.15) was started on 2026-11-20 on the user's "Start Batch C when Preview is done". The review uses eight new Flash photos of new people, one per pair of Unit 2 steps: a woman at the gym, a man cycling to his office, a girl with a camera, a boy by the elevator on the third floor, a woman in yellow choosing yellow apples, a taller girl in light blue beside a boy in dark blue, a teenager using his phone in class and two women showing their watches. Each fact is offered twice: as a picture item, whose wrong pictures are the other photos, and as a sentence item, whose wrong options change only the reviewed form.

lesson.title: 2.14 Review: new people, new places
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Review every A1+ Unit 2 step with new people: where they go and how, what they have, short forms, but, ordinals, favorite, -es and irregular plurals, ones, -er than, Don't and light/dark, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.14 Unit 2 Review: A1 reviews Unit 2 with fresh scenes; A1+ 2.14 reviews every A1+ Unit 2 step with eight fresh photos of new people and no new language: goes to (2.1), How does … go …? and by bike (2.2), has and Does … have …? (2.3), What's, It's and isn't (2.4), but (2.5), the third floor and lives on (2.6-2.7), favorite (2.8), women and watches (2.9), ones (2.10), taller than (2.11), Don't (2.12) and light or dark blue (2.13). Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say what new people do and have, where they live and go, and compare and describe them, with every Unit 2 form, at a natural pace.
